title: Serve before complaint takes the mouth
summary: Serving the True Guru receives Naam into the mind until peace outlasts the urge to protest.
takeaway: Serve until peace has more authority than complaint.
lifeApplication: Before sharpening the complaint, take one act of service that obeys the Guru's way; let the mouth speak after the mind has softened.

source.shortMeaning: Those who serve the True Guru receive Naam, and complaint loses its hold as peace settles in the mind.
source.lifeApplication: When protest rises, serve in the Guru's way first and let the mouth grow quieter before it speaks.

evidence.coreClaim: Those who serve the True Guru receive Naam, and complaint loses its hold as peace settles in the mind.
evidence.turn: Let service become the place where Naam quiets the protest you were ready to repeat.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before sharpening the complaint, take one act of service that obeys the Guru's way; let the mouth speak after the mind has softened.
